allowInputDrag.zh-CN: 在原生 input、textarea 上按下时是否允许拖动。
allowInputDrag.en-US: Whether dragging is allowed when pressing on a native input or textarea.

allowMove.zh-CN: 按下时判断是否允许拖动的函数，返回 false 则不拖动。
allowMove.en-US: Function that decides whether a drag may start on pointer down; returning false prevents it.

children.zh-CN: 被拖动的内容。每个顶层 DOM 元素各自可拖动，文本节点无法拖动。
children.en-US: The content to drag. Each top-level DOM element is dragged on its own; text nodes cannot be dragged.

constrainer.zh-CN: 限制拖动范围的元素：`'parent'` 表示父级元素，或返回该元素的函数；该元素需要为 relative 定位。
constrainer.en-US: The element that limits the draggable range: `'parent'` for the parent element, or a function that returns it. It needs to be positioned relatively.

customMove.zh-CN: 自定义拖动后的位置处理；设置后组件只在 requestAnimationFrame 中回传计算出的位置，不再改写元素的 top 与 left。
customMove.en-US: Custom position handling after dragging. When set, the component only passes the calculated position back in requestAnimationFrame and no longer writes the element's top and left.

handler.zh-CN: 返回触发拖动的元素，返回 null 时回退为被拖动元素本身。
handler.en-US: Returns the element that triggers dragging. Falls back to the dragged element itself when it returns null.

onMouseDown.zh-CN: 鼠标或触控笔按下时触发。
onMouseDown.en-US: Called when a mouse or pen pointer is pressed.

onMouseMove.zh-CN: 鼠标或触控笔移动时触发。
onMouseMove.en-US: Called when a mouse or pen pointer moves.

onMouseUp.zh-CN: 鼠标或触控笔抬起时触发。
onMouseUp.en-US: Called when a mouse or pen pointer is released.

onTouchCancel.zh-CN: 指针被系统取消（pointercancel）时触发。
onTouchCancel.en-US: Called when the pointer is cancelled by the system (pointercancel).

onTouchEnd.en-US: Called when a touch pointer is released.

onTouchMove.en-US: Called when a touch pointer moves.

onTouchStart.en-US: Called when a touch pointer is pressed.

positionStrategy.zh-CN: 定位策略，relative 保留元素原有的布局位置。
positionStrategy.en-US: Positioning strategy. relative keeps the element's original layout position.
